# Hong in Canada

> Personal site of Hong — a Product Builder with an HCI background and engineering leadership experience. The site hosts long-form writing on building software with AI, product design, and shipping side projects. All content is authored by Hong.

## About
- [Home / About Hong](https://www.hongincanada.com): Background in Human-Computer Interaction, product mindset, and engineering leadership.
